synopsis.text: Cap is brought, via S.H.I.E.L.D. transportation, to the ruins of the castle in which Baron Zemo had booby trapped the drone plane which exploded, sending Cap into the drink and his deep freeze, and apparently killing Bucky. Later, Cap is involved with foiling the bad guys once again while saving Agent 13 (Sharon Carter) and we see the Winter Soldier who takes aim at Cap,and is told not to shoot (per Lukin). The cosmic cube is whole and back.
